verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic browser session creation: Browserbase launch, local launch, and CDP attach. It also shows Browserbase contexts for persisting session data, multi-region placement, and a session dashboard. Nothing in the pack covers running many sessions in parallel or any documented concurrency limits. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or quotas, evidence of running a fleet of concurrent sessions, programmatic session listing or termination APIs, and independent corroboration of parallel-scale usage.
